title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Brooke's Point, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Brooke's Point National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Brooke's Point, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Brooke's Point National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Brooke's Point, Tỉnh Palawan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Brooke's Point
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Brooke's Point, จังหวัด Palawan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Brooke's Point
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Brooke's Point, Provinsi Palawan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Brooke's Point
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Brooke's Point, Wilayah Palawan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Brooke's Point

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school in the Municipality of Brooke's Point, Province of Palawan, with school site at Barangay Pangobilian, to be known as the Brooke's Point National High School.
the Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act.
the amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approve,
